mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: UBO identification and shareholding disclosure form (Angaben zum wirtschaftlich Berechtigten)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille OR Consular Legalization where required

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory pre-incorporation screening of every shareholder, UBO, managing director and authorized representative against the EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, the United Nations Sanctions List, the U.S. OFAC Specially Designated Nationals and Blocked Persons List, German Federal Gazette (Bundesanzeiger) sanctions notices, and the German PEP database as required by the German Money Laundering Act (GwG Sections 2, 3, 6, 11 and 12). Enhanced due diligence applies where any UBO is a foreign Politically Exposed Person (PEP), where the transaction originates from a FATF high-risk third country, or where the intended payment rails are SWIFT letters of credit or telegraphic transfers with intermediate banks. Screening results must be documented in the notarial incorporation protocol and retained for at least five years.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Unternehmensregister (www.unternehmensregister.de) and the electronic Commercial Register (Handelsregister) filing system via German notary
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Under Section 18 of the German Commercial Code (HGB), the company name must be clearly distinguishable and must not be misleading. Latin characters are accepted, including German umlauts (ae, oe, ue, ss transliteration may be used for non-German payment rails and electronic systems). A foreign-language trade name may be registered, but where the corporate object or business scope is not clearly apparent, a descriptive German addition must be included to satisfy clarity requirements.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Name clearance is submitted electronically and notarially to the Registrar of the Commercial Register (Registergericht). Upon formal rejection of the proposed name, the notary files an administrative objection (Erinnerung) with the Registry Court within two weeks of the rejection notice. If the objection is unsuccessful, an immediate appeal (Beschwerde) may be lodged with the Higher Regional Court (Oberlandesgericht) within one month of the adverse decision. The appeal must specify the grounds of distinctiveness and non-deception under Section 18 HGB. A further non-statutory name check against the German Patent and Trade Mark Office (DPMA) and the Madrid System is recommended before filing.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Conditionally accepted. A virtual office address may be registered as the Geschaeftsanschrift for commercial register filing and for receiving legal service, but the medical device manufacturing business under ISIC 3250 / EU MDR requires a real physical presence in Germany for regulatory technical documentation, post-market surveillance, and quality system audits. A virtual-only office will not satisfy BfArM or Notified Body expectations for the manufacture of microfluidic cartridges and immunoassay analyzers. A local operational facility, warehouse, or authorized agent with physical substance is mandatory before obtaining the statutory license and CE marking.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: High: approximately 70–80% cumulative probability of an unannounced or scheduled medical device quality-system audit within the first 24 months after certification by the Notified Body or BfArM; and a 15–25% annualized risk of spot checks by German trade offices (Gewerbeamt) or tax authorities on the registered office and actual commercial substance of the UG.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Handelsgesetzbuch (HGB) and Act on Private Limited Companies (GmbHG) §§ 1-13 for Unternehmergesellschaft (haftungsbeschränkt)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Handelsregister at the Amtsgericht (local commercial court)
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Gründungsurkunde (Articles of Association) and Handelsregistereintragung (Commercial Register Entry)
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: Minimum 1 Euro for UG; capital must be paid in and documented; no escrow required but funds must be available prior to registration
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: Pro Forma First Board Resolution: The directors of the proposed Unternehmergesellschaft (haftungsbeschränkt) resolve unanimously as follows: (1) To subscribe to one share of the Company with a par value of one Euro (EUR 1.00), thereby setting the initial share capital at one Euro; (2) To designate the registered office at [full German address]; (3) To appoint [Director Name 1] and [Director Name 2] as managing directors (Geschäftsführer) with full authority to represent the Company in all legal and business matters; (4) To authorize the managing directors to file the articles of association and all required incorporation documents with the competent commercial register (Handelsregister) and to complete all necessary registrations; (5) To approve the draft articles of association presented to the meeting. This resolution is passed by all directors present and is effective immediately upon signing. Date: [Insert Date]. Signatures: [Director 1], [Director 2].

step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Access the official Handelsregister portal or visit the local Amtsgericht to reserve the proposed company name and obtain a reservation certificate confirming availability.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is unavailable, select an alternative name and re-submit the reservation application

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Notarization of Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Engage a notary to draft and notarize the articles of association (Satzung) specifying the company object, share capital, managing directors, and registered office.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If queried, provide additional explanations or amend the articles and re-notarize

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Capital Deposit and Bank Account Opening
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Deposit the minimum capital of 1 Euro into a dedicated company bank account and obtain a deposit confirmation certificate.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If deposit is questioned, provide bank statements and re-verify

step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the incorporation application including notarized articles, capital proof, and identity documents; submit electronically or in person and obtain the registration certificate.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If application is queried, submit missing documents or request procedural review

step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register the company with the tax office for income tax, VAT (USt-ID), and social security via the ELSTER online portal or in person.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If queried, provide additional tax forms or documentation

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Bundesinstitut für Arzneimittel und Medizinprodukte (BfArM) and local trade supervision authority (Gewerbeamt)
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Manufacturing Permit for Medical Devices under the Medical Devices Act (MPG) and CE Marking

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Umweltbundesamt (Federal Environment Agency) and local environmental protection agency (Umweltamt)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Registration or Full EIA Report depending on scale; typically Registration for small-scale manufacturing
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Compliance with German Ordinance on Emissions (TA Luft), wastewater discharge limits per Abwasserverordnung, and waste handling regulations under Kreislaufwirtschaftsgesetz

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Certification by local fire authority (Feuerwehr) for fire safety and structural integrity; occupational health and safety clearance from the competent Berufsgenossenschaft (trade association); workplace inspection by Gewerbeaufsichtsamt

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Bundeszentralamt für Steuern (BZSt) / Federal Central Tax Office, together with the local Finanzamt (tax office); central digital portal: ELSTER (www.elster.de)
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: The UG must submit the 'Fragebogen zur steuerlichen Erfassung' (tax registration questionnaire) via the ELSTER portal to the competent local Finanzamt. The Finanzamt issues the domestic tax number (Steuernummer). For cross-border and intra-Community transactions, the UG must separately apply to the BZSt for a VAT identification number (USt-IdNr.) using the official national application form. Foreign entities without a domestic seat may apply directly to the BZSt, generally after registration with the local Finanzamt or through a fiscal representative if legally required.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation (UG is a German corporate body subject to corporation tax, trade tax, and solidarity surcharge; no pass-through treatment available)
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No US-style check-the-box election exists. A UG may elect VAT fiscal unity (Organschaft) with its parent undertaking, and, where materially integrated, corporate-trade tax group status (Steuerorganschaft) via profit and loss pooling. Hybrid mismatch limitations under §4k EStG prevent elective avoidance of double non-taxation consistent with ATAD.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: The German small-business exemption applies where previous-year gross turnover did not exceed EUR 22,000 and current-year expected turnover does not exceed EUR 50,000. Non-established foreign suppliers may become compulsorily VAT-registered irrespective of turnover.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Germany does not operate real-time fiscal clearance, digital stamping, or tax-authority API pre-clearance for standard domestic transactions. E-invoicing obligations are phased in from 1 January 2025 for domestic B2B supplies; e-invoices must comply with EN 16931 and be transmitted in structured formats (XRechnung/ZUGFeRD). A valid invoice requiring a VAT ID and sequential invoice number remains mandatory; e-Invoice requirements also apply to B2G supplies without threshold.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating for physical exports applies where the IVD goods are delivered by the UG to a non-EU customer or to an EU consolidator without domestic consumption, satisfying the substantive conditions of §4 Nr.1 and §6 UStG. In each case the UG must evidence the export in conformity with the customs export declaration (Ausfuhrnachweis), including the customs office of exit on a valid export declaration. Services, including software/technical support for point-of-care IVD analyzers, may be zero-rated as B2B supplies to non-resident recipients under §3a UStG when the recipient has its seat or permanent establishment outside the EU/EEA.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Ausfuhrnachweis / Abgangs- und Ausfuhrsbescheinigung) covering the goods and declared export office
Bill of Lading (for sea freight) or Air Waybill (for air freight) evidencing transport to a non-EU destination
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank wire confirmation demonstrating the foreign buyer’s payment from outside Germany
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Exports are subject to documentary audit by the Finanzamt and customs authorities. Failure to produce the required export proof within the statutory period obliges the UG to self-correct VAT at 19% plus statutory interest (§233a AO); fraudulent or negligent export zero-rating claims expose the UG to VAT reassessment, civil penalties up to twice the evaded tax, and criminal prosecution for tax evasion under §370 AO, together with retrospective clawbacks under falsified or missing documentation.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Euro operates under full capital account convertibility per EU liberalization directives; no prior approval required for most capital transactions; profit remittances unrestricted subject to standard tax and AML documentation; capital versus current account distinctions do not apply due to harmonized EU FX framework; remittance hurdles limited to beneficial ownership verification and source-of-funds attestations.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No mandatory surrender or forced conversion of export proceeds; companies retain proceeds in foreign currency accounts for free conversion; statistical reporting mandatory via customs declarations (Zoll) and Intrastat for values exceeding thresholds; no statutory timelines or conversion ratios imposed under current EU FX regulations.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low viability for standalone cross-border EMI operations due to BaFin licensing mandates including minimum capital of EUR 350,000, robust consumer protection standards, and integration requirements with licensed banking rails; partnerships with established institutions recommended to navigate regulatory constraints.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence of directors or authorized signatories required for initial KYC interviews and corporate onboarding at German commercial banks; remote digital KYC permitted for subsequent transactions and ongoing operations but core setup mandates in-person verification to satisfy AML and identity documentation protocols.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Extract from Handelsregister, proof of identity and address for all directors, and source of funds documentation
Negative screening certificates, PEP declarations, and adverse media reports
Business plan, export contracts for IVD equipment, and proof of manufacturing licenses

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant inbound capital via SWIFT MT103 wires using purpose code 'CAPITAL CONTRIBUTION' or 'EQUITY INJECTION'; verification through company register extracts, shareholder agreements, and Form A FX reporting for non-resident ownership; all transactions subject to standard AML source-of-funds checks.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound trade settlements cleared primarily via SWIFT MT103 for TT wires and Commercial Letters of Credit; payments aligned with Incoterms upon shipment confirmation; target rails include Swift_LC and TT_Wire for IVD equipment exports.

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 15.0% corporate income tax (Körperschaftsteuer) plus 5.5% solidarity surcharge (Solidaritätszuschlag) on the corporate income tax amount, plus municipal trade tax (Gewerbesteuer) at the statutory base rate of 3.5% multiplied by the municipal Hebesatz; the combined effective rate is typically 28.3%–33.0% depending on the municipality, e.g. Berlin: 30.175%, Munich: 32.975%.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No statutory corporate tax holidays. Available preferential relief includes the German research allowance (Forschungszulage) of 25% of qualifying research and development expenditure up to EUR 10 million per year, enhanced declining-balance depreciation for 2024/2025, and loss carryback currently limited to EUR 2 million in 2024 with subsequent reduction to EUR 1 million; loss carryforward is governed by German minimum taxation rules.
